headline: Australia Treasurer Flags Public Service Savings in Mid-Year Budget Update
summary: Australian Treasurer Jim Chalmers announced plans to target efficiency savings across the public service ahead of releasing the government's mid-year economic and fiscal outlook.
why: The Australian Department of the Treasury publishes periodic economic updates outlining sovereign revenue and expenditure forecasts.
